thread:
Natalie (PM): Quick sync — finalizing the customer story for EmberPilot. Need legal approval on a single quote and routing for inbound leads post-launch. Draft attached.
Samir (Content): Thanks — uploaded the latest draft with the pull quote labeled "Q1". Also added two social copy options.
Natalie (PM): Great. Q1 is from their Head of Ops, short and punchy. Can legal check for confidentiality/attribution? We have an embargo: 2024-02-09 10:00 PT.
Ezra (Legal): Got it. Skimming now. Two flags: (1) the phrase "reduced inference costs by 60%" — need backup or change to "significantly reduced inference costs" unless they have a number we can cite. (2) We need explicit consent for the product feature name mention. Please send the release consent form.
Natalie (PM): Good catch. Samir — can you replace the exact percent with a qualitative line unless we get a number? I'll ping the customer for consent form.
Samir (Content): Updated copy: "reduced inference costs and cut latency" — more conservative. Kept an alternate with "~60%" in parens if they confirm. Uploaded as EmberPilot_v3.docx.
Maya (PR): Also adding webinar CTA in the corner box: "Join EmberPilot + Redwood webinar — 2024-02-16". Who's owning the registration page?
Ivy (Sales): I'll own the registration funnel and the post-demo lead routing. Please tag me when the press list goes live. We need to map inbound leads to AE queue: AE-West for US, AE-EMEA for EU, and a partner track for key accounts.
Natalie (PM): Ivy noted. Samir — please add a one-line "how to raise a trial request" CTA, so Sales has a clear handoff.
Samir (Content): Added: "Request a trial — link will route you to your regional AE." Inline copy in the doc now.
Ezra (Legal): Quick redline summary: changed the hard stat, added consent checklist item, and recommended we remove customer internal product code names. I attached legal_redlines_170812.pdf.
Natalie (PM): Thanks Ezra. I sent the consent form to EmberPilot's legal contact (cc'd). Also scheduling a 20-min signoff call tomorrow 9:30 PT.
press-bot: Reminder: embargo metadata set for 2024-02-09T18:00:00Z (do not publish until embargo lifts).
Maya (PR): Perf — once consent is back and legal clears, I'll queue the post in Buffer, and coordinate with Growth for the two social variants. Would love a second quote if the customer can provide a quick line about latency impact.
Samir (Content): Sent a short prompt to the customer: "Could you add one sentence on latency impact?" Offered a 1-2 sentence template to reduce back-and-forth.
Ivy (Sales): For inbound mapping: can you add the UTMs we want? I recommend campaign=ember-launch, source=social/email, medium=cta. Also please add lead priority tag: 'case-study-interest'.
Natalie (PM): Adding UTMs and lead tag now. Samir — new task: final social copy needs to be under 280 chars and two tone options (technical and product).
Samir (Content): Will do. ETA 3pm PT today.
Ezra (Legal): One more note: if they want the exact percent quoted later, we need a short signed addendum to the consent form. Keep that thread open.
Natalie (PM): Noted. If consent isn't returned by EOD tomorrow, we publish with conservative language and the webinar stays but no metric callouts.
Maya (PR): Sounds like a plan. Once legal clears I'll run the press list and tag Ivy for lead mapping.
Ivy (Sales): Cool. I'll prepare the AE rotation and Slack alert template for the inbound leads. Ping me when the launch page URL is ready.
Samir (Content): Draft social variants done and uploaded as ember_social_options.txt.
Natalie (PM): Thanks team. Follow-ups: (1) Ezra — final signoff after consent, (2) EmberPilot reply, (3) Ivy — ready routing, (4) Maya — scheduling Buffer & press list. Back here after the 9:30 PT signoff call. :thumbsup:
